correctness.rationale: The square-free lifting theorem reduces ordinary complex Fourier principal nonsingularity at 154=11·14 to characteristic-11 principal nonsingularity at 14. Independently reconstructed GF(11^3) as F11[a]/(a^3+a+4), tested the irreducible cubic and generator order 1330, selected both Frobenius orbits of primitive 14th roots (representatives 1 and 3), and independently evaluated all 16,383 nonempty principal minors in each orbit by exact finite-field elimination: 32,766/32,766 nonzero. Frobenius preserves nonzero and the published lifting theorem supplies the infinite/complex conclusion; no nonprincipal minor claim.
residual_risks: Relies on independently read published conditional square-free lifting theorem rather than reproving it from scratch.
